About the role

We're looking for an Operational Risk Manager to join IMC's Operational Risk Management (ORM) team and lead operational risk frameworks and prudential risk across our European offices.

The key focus areas for this role are split between operational risk and prudential risk. Operational risk covers the Key Control Framework (KCF), Risk Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), risk surveys, risk culture, and Business Continuity Planning (BCP). Prudential risk focuses on IFR/IFD regulatory frameworks including the Internal Capital Adequacy and Risk Assessment (ICARA) process, Pillar 3 disclosures, prudential reporting, and participation in IFR-related working groups across associations (EPTA, APT) and regulators (FCA, DNB).

You will partner with Trading, Technology, Compliance, and other teams across the organization to ensure risk controls are appropriately embedded in systems and processes. The role reports to the European Head of Risk and is based in Amsterdam, with regular travel across our European offices (London, Zug, Aarhus). You will join a growing dedicated ORM team as the second member and collaborate with ORM colleagues globally.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

  • Own and continuously enhance the Key Control Framework, ensuring effective testing, monitoring, and assurance of critical firm-wide controls
  • Conduct annual Risk Survey, Culture assesment and Risk Control Self-Assessment process to ensure proactive and consistent identification, evaluation, and mitigation of key risks
  • Partner with Trading, Technology, Compliance and other teams to ensure risk controls are appropriately embedded in systems and processes
  • Lead Business Continuity Planning (BCP) processes and testing across European offices
  • Lead ongoing IFR/IFD prudential risk management for Amsterdam and London entities
  • Own the Internal Capital Adequacy and Risk Assessment (ICARA) process, Pillar 3 disclosures, and prudential reporting for both jurisdictions
  • Participate in IFR-related working groups across associations (EPTA, APT) and engage with regulators (FCA, DNB) on prudential risk matters

Your Skills and Experience:

  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing Operational Risk frameworks, including RCSA and Key Control frameworks

About the Position

Our goals are to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street as a Machine Learning Researcher while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You'll work side by side with experienced ML Researchers on projects that we've selected for their combination of novel ML ideas and relevance to real-world systematic trading strategies. You'll learn how we think about markets through challenging classes and activities, and practice using established methods alongside our own unique twists to train practical models.

At Jane Street, the lines between research, technology, and trading are intentionally blurry, and you’ll have access to petabytes of data, a computing cluster with hundreds of thousands of cores, and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges—large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment—that force us to search for novel techniques.

You'll spend the bulk of your internship working closely with full-time machine learning researchers on projects drawn from their own work. You might conduct an end-to-end study of an unexplored dataset, try a new modelling paradigm for a thorny problem, or consider blue-sky approaches that we're still trying to figure out. The problems we work on rarely have clean, definitive answers, and they often require insights from colleagues across the firm with different areas of expertise. Depending on the day, you might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging training issues, or analysing the predictions your model makes.

Note that given the IP-sensitive nature of machine learning research at Jane Street, it is unlikely that any research findings associated with the internship will be suitable for outside academic publication.

About you

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

  • An undergraduate, PhD student, or postdoc with practical experience working on ML problems
  • Interested in applying logical and mathematical thinking to all kinds of problems
  • Curious about the machine learning landscape and excited to apply state-of-the-art techniques drawn from many problem domains
  • Fluent with a versatile set of models and tricks
  • Able to rapidly implement and iterate on your ideas in Python and your favourite ML framework
  • Eager to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things
  • Fluent in English

If you'd like to learn more, you can read about our interview process and meet some of the team. Learn more about Jane Street's internship program here.

About the Position

We're looking for Linux Engineers to join the team that maintains the critical infrastructure underlying the rest of Jane Street's technology. It's a broad role, and no two Linux Engineers look exactly alike. Our work spans on-prem and cloud infrastructure, every major pillar (compute, storage, networking), and every layer of the stack from the physical hardware to workload orchestration. You should expect to work in some (but not necessarily all) of these areas, and to go genuinely deep in a few.

That might mean:

  • Building the in-house tools and systems that make up our platform, or integrating mainstream (often open-source) technologies so they feel native to our infrastructure
  • Acting as one of the firm's Linux experts, and teaching other engineers specialist skills like systems debugging
  • Automating our own work, because it makes us faster and more reliable (and we think it's fun)
  • Diagnosing and resolving production issues in real time, often under time pressure
  • Carrying out scheduled changes to the platform, like upgrades, migrations, capacity changes, and rollouts, planned meticulously and executed carefully

The problem space runs from the physical to the abstract: datacenter provisioning and orchestration, kernels and drivers delivered through Nix and RPMs, production and research storage at scale, cloud that integrates cleanly with our on-prem platform, and, in partnership with our IT and Network Engineering colleagues, Linux desktops and how our hosts participate in the network.

We see Linux Engineering and Software Engineering as two ends of a spectrum, and plenty of people could do either job well. Linux Engineering is likely the better fit if you treat Linux itself as your problem space: you like working close to the operating system, you want to look after production infrastructure, and you're happy spending more of your time in a consulting capacity than a typical developer would. (Compared with kernel development, the emphasis flips: you'd rarely develop the kernel itself, though targeted patches happen, and you'd spend far more time running production infrastructure.) We're hiring for both roles and are happy to advise you on which might fit best.

We don't expect you to come in with deep experience; we're happy to hire smart problem-solvers and teach them what they need to know. But the job leans much more toward engineering than a traditional operations role: relentless automation instead of manual toil, and a large body of in-house technology rather than only off-the-shelf tools. You'll build systems, not just operate them.

Maven Securities is a leading proprietary trading firm that leverages sophisticated technology and quantitative analysis to trade in global financial markets. We specialize in options and derivatives market making, where your skills can be directly applied to have a real impact.

At Maven, we believe exceptional careers are built deliberately. Our graduate program is designed for a small number of high-potential individuals each year, combining comprehensive training, real responsibility, and long-term development. We don’t hire large classes with the expectation that only a few will succeed, we invest in every individual who joins the team.

Program details:

  • Location: Chicago (based in London for training period)
  • Program start date: September 6th, 2027
  • Application deadline: Rolling basis

Base salary: $150,000-175,000 dependent on education and experience 

You’ll begin with a structured 7-week training program in London, designed to prepare you for a career in quantitative research. This initial phase focuses on building the technical foundations and professional skills needed for the role, as well as forming crucial working relationships with your UK counterparts - both on the Graduate Program and more senior stakeholders. 

Following training, you’ll return to Chicago and roll onto two project rotations, where you’ll continue to learn through hands-on experience. Maven offers a few days of leave to support this transition, as well as travel, accommodation and relocation support. 

What you will be doing:

  • Design, evaluate and continuously improve our automated trading algorithms
  • Build quantitative pricing models, for example American Option Pricing and Volatility Modeling
  • Research and analyze trading data to find and test trading opportunities

How and what you will learn:

  • Progress through a structured onboarding program with clear learning milestones
  • Build your foundation through theory and exercise-led training, led by Maven’s Head of Technology Training & Graduates
  • Learn about financial markets, our platforms and specific quant research field for OMM, apply your academic research abilities and learn how to perform research on real-world data of varied volume and sampling frequency across a variety of domains
  • We will teach you how to use and master Maven’s in-house tools and systems. Maven utilizes the latest technology in order to meet and exceed our demanding business challenges
  • Attend regular check-ins with the Quant Researcher and Emerging Talent teams

Who you are:

Key criteria:

  • A Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD student in applied mathematics, statistics, engineering or physics 
  • Relevant programming experience in at least one language (Python, C++, C#)
  • Proactive interest in improving existing trading strategies and identifying new opportunities
  • Motivated for quantitative research, financial services and trading, with knowledge of financial markets 
  • A willingness to adopt and utilise emerging AI technologies

We’re looking for someone who is:

  • An entrepreneurial thinker with the ability to generate ideas, take initiative and drive innovation
  • A critical problem solver and decision maker who can analyze situations, think clearly and make effective decisions
  • An agile learner who is able to quickly acquire knowledge, take on feedback, adapt and apply insights across different contexts
  • Able to synthesize information, resolve conflicting inputs, see the bigger picture, and translate complex information into actionable recommendations
  • Collaborative and influential, able to build trust, work effectively with others and positively impact the team
  • Results-focused and accountable, taking ownership and delivering outcomes reliably

Why Maven?:

  • Dedicated In-House Trainers: Gain the tools to succeed in a rapidly evolving market, where AI is integral to our strategy and daily operations. Our tailored curriculums are led by in-house experts and cover both technical and professional skills, as well as guidance on how to adopt AI best practices
  • Accelerate Your Career: Every permanent colleague receives a dedicated learning and development budget, full access to our online learning platform, and frequent training sessions led by our Maven experts
  • Proven Pathways: Benefit from our structured pipeline programs that set you up for long-term success. Around a quarter of Maven’s workforce joined through an Emerging Talent Program, with many staying from Spring Week through the Graduate Program and beyond
  • Supported to Succeed: We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can perform at your best. We offer recruitment support where needed, and employee resource groups that help build community across the firm
  • Grow with Guidance: Enjoy regular feedback, structured review points, and informal off-desk chats. Everyone in our Emerging Talent Programs is also paired with a Maven buddy for practical advice and day-to-day support
  • Make a Real Impact, Fast: From the start of the projects, you’ll be embedded in the team and learn directly from other Quant Researchers. After this, you’ll transition onto a permanent position within the team, where you’ll continue building upon the skills taught in the program

Please note:

  • We accept one application per candidate, per recruitment cycle
  • Visa sponsorship is available for selected roles, please see our FAQ page for details

Maven is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law. 

Benefits at Maven

As a graduate joining Maven, you’ll be eligible for a range of benefits, including:

  • 25 days of PTO plus US national holidays, which we expect you to take
  • Private medical and dental cover, eye care support, life assurance, 401k or Roth retirement plans, and an Employee Assistance Program
  • Consideration for a discretionary annual bonus
  • An annual learning and development budget, alongside wider training and development opportunities
  • Wellness benefits, including free use of the building gym and access to ClassPass
  • Frequent social events, from welcome dinners and summer parties to company sports leagues and boat tours!
  • Daily breakfast in the office and a lunch allowance, plus snacks and drinks throughout the day
  • Enhanced family-friendly policies, including maternity, paternity, adoption, fertility and partner’s leave
  • Work in a forward-thinking environment where AI is integral to our strategy and daily operations

Maven’s Systematic Equities team deploys research-driven strategies across global equity markets, powered by some of the most advanced technology available. Our approach to trading is scientific and process-driven, with a strong emphasis on a flexible research environment, providing us with efficient means to rapidly develop, test, and deploy new ideas. We empower our team members and maximise their ability to succeed by offering an environment that is open, collaborative, and supportive. We value creativity and are aggressive to capitalise on opportunities.

The role:

We are seeking a Senior Quantitative Researcher to join a systematic equities investment team. The role focuses on the research, development, and implementation of quantitative equity strategies across global developed markets. The successful candidate will contribute across the full investment research lifecycle, including data acquisition, alpha signal research, portfolio construction, backtesting, production implementation, and ongoing strategy monitoring.

Job Description

  • Conduct quantitative research to develop alpha signals for systematic equity strategies across global markets, including developed and emerging markets.
  • Research and implement cross-sectional equity signals using traditional financial data, alternative datasets, and advanced statistical or machine learning techniques.
  • Design, test, and improve idiosyncratic, factor-neutral and long/short  systematic strategies.
  • Evaluate alpha signals and strategies through rigorous backtesting, performance attribution, robustness analysis, and out-of-sample testing.
  • Apply machine learning methods such as tree-based models, graphical models, NLP, explainable AI, dimensionality reduction, and network-based approaches to investment research.
  • Collaborate with portfolio managers, researchers, data engineers, and technology teams to translate research ideas into production-ready investment strategies.
  • Contribute to the development of internal research tools, analytics platforms, and model evaluation frameworks.
  • Stay current with academic and industry developments in quantitative finance, machine learning, alternative data, and systematic investing.

Required Qualifications 

  • Advanced degree (Masters or Ph.D.) in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, physics, economics, financial engineering.
  • 8+ years experience in quantitative research, systematic equities, asset management, hedge funds, proprietary trading, or a related investment environment
  • Strong understanding of equity markets, factor investing, alpha research, portfolio construction, and risk management 
  • Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, with experience working with large financial datasets and research infrastructure.
  • Solid knowledge of statistics, econometrics, machine learning, optimization, and time-series or cross-sectional modelling.
  • Ability to work independently across the full research lifecycle, from idea generation to live deployment.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex quantitative concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Academic teaching, publishing, or thought leadership in machine learning, quantitative finance, or systematic investing is a plus.

Associate/Senior Associate, Quantitative Investment Analyst, Portfolio Solutions

Brookfield’s Public Securities Group serves institutions and individuals seeking the investment advantages of real assets through actively managed listed equity and debt strategies. The Public Securities Group leverages Brookfield’s core real asset expertise across real estate, infrastructure, real asset debt, real asset solutions and opportunistic strategies through a variety of flexible and scalable investment mandates, including separate accounts, registered funds and private funds. Clients include financial institutions, public and private pension plans, insurance companies, endowments and foundations, sovereign wealth funds and high net worth investors. The Public Securities Group has been investing in public securities for over 30 years and has over $28 billion of assets under management. For more information, visit https://publicsecurities.brookfield.com.

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

The Investment Solutions Group (ISG) at Brookfield is responsible for designing and managing customized investment strategies across the firm’s global alternatives platform, including real estate, infrastructure, renewable power, private equity, and credit. The team partners closely with institutional and wealth clients to develop tailored portfolio solutions that align with specific objectives such as income generation, inflation protection, and long-term capital appreciation.

ISG plays a central role in product development, portfolio construction, investment selection and capital formation, structuring bespoke mandates, commingled vehicles, and strategic partnerships. By leveraging Brookfield’s integrated platform, the group connects client needs with investment opportunities, providing differentiated, scalable solutions across global markets.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement portfolio optimization frameworks for private market portfolios across multiple asset classes.
  • Develop optimization models that incorporate illiquidity, capital calls, distributions, pacing, vintage diversification, sector/geographic constraints, and leverage.
  • Develop quantitative models for expected returns, risk, cash flow forecasting, and correlations across private market investments.
  • Build simulation engines using Monte Carlo and scenario analysis to evaluate portfolio outcomes under different economic environments.
  • Work with private market data providers (Cambridge, MSCI/Burgiss/Preqin) and internal historical investment data to provide asset class level insight and research
  • Contribute to the build out of private market risk measurements (factor models, de-smoothing volatility, manager/investment level dispersion, stress testing)
  • Work closely with Portfolio Managers, fundamental investment analysts, and risk management
  • Contribute to thought leadership pieces and whitepapers on private portfolio construction, design, and risk assessment

The Candidate:

The successful candidate will possess the following:

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or another highly quantitative field
  • 4+ experience within a leading private markets investment manager, pension fund, sovereign wealth fund, endowment, OCIO, or asset manager.
  • Strong understanding of private market cash flow dynamics including capital calls, distributions, NAV evolution, commitment pacing, liquidity forecasting
  • Strong programming skills within SQL, Python and experience with portfolio optimization software preferred (Gurobi, Mosek, etc..)
  • Experience working with factor models used in portfolio construction and risk management (Bloomberg, Barra, Axioma, etc..)
  • Knowledge of portfolio optimization techniques used to target different outcomes (yield, volatility, MOIC maximation, downside protection) with complex constraints.
  • Effective communicator, both oral and written, with ability to present with clarity, precision and conviction
  • Experience working with large datasets and data visualization tools (Tableau, Python, R)
  • Able to prioritize and work independently on multiple tasks to ensure that complex projects are completed by deadline, with interim review steps incorporated

Brookfield is committed to maintaining a Positive Work Environment that is safe and respectful; our shared success depends on it. Accordingly, we do not tolerate workplace discrimination, violence or harassment.

We are proud to create a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are grateful for your interest in this position, however, only candidates selected for pre-screening will be contacted.

  • Support senior team members in structuring private investments for an insurance balance sheet to be efficiently capitalized, including preparing analyses that inform structural decisions

  • Conduct market and sector research to inform investment decisions and identify structuring trends relevant to the team's target asset classes

Candidate Profile

  • Minimum 2-4 years of experience in reading/analyzing documentation of CLO or ABS securitizations, warehouse, and asset-backed financings; experience in multiple asset classes a plus
  • Exposure to rating agency processes and securitization methodologies; direct rating agency interaction a plus
  • Knowledge or familiarity with insurance investment management a plus
  • Demonstrated proficiencies in MS Excel, PowerPoint, VBA, and Intex;
  • Proactive self-starter with high attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and motivation
  • Ability to work concurrently across multiple live transactions and asset classes
  • Excellent organizational and communication (verbal and written) skills

Balyasny Asset Management (BAM) is a diversified global investment firm founded in 2001 by Dmitry Balyasny, Scott Schroeder, and Taylor O'Malley. With over $32 billion in assets under management, BAM employs more than 2,000 people across 23 offices in the U.S. and Canada, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. The firm’s investment teams span five strategies, including Equities Long/Short, Fixed Income & Macro, Commodities, Multi-Asset Arbitrage, and Systematic. Balyasny’s mission is to deliver to its investors absolute, uncorrelated returns in all market environments.


Overview:

Top global hedge fund seeks a talented, energetic self-starter for a Desktop Support Engineer position. Candidate must have a minimum of 5 years’ experience at a hedge fund/financial institution, supporting MS Windows Desktop/Server environments leveraging the latest tools and concepts in order to provide exceptional service delivery across the enterprise. The optimal candidate will be process driven and have a diverse technology background with a desire to learn and become the best. A basic understanding of financial markets and trade lifecycles is a plus. The candidate must be an exceptional problem solver and a very strong communicator with the ability to multitask.

 

In the role of Desktop Support Engineer, the employee responsibilities will include:


  • Provide global end-user and desktop support in a fast-paced environment (includes all offices, remote and executive leadership support)
  • Office 365 applications and Windows 10 operating system support
  • Microsoft Active Directory and Office 365 Exchange Online management
  • Citrix Cloud/Microsoft Azure VDA/VDI platform management and support
  • HP Workstation, HP Thin Client, Lenovo laptop management and support
  • Cisco VoIP phones, Cisco Unified CM and Cisco Unity Connection Administration
  • Mobile device (iOS, Android) support managed through MDM platform (MobileIron)
  • Supporting video conferencing systems (Zoom, Neat, Poly)
  • Supporting Market Data Applications (Bloomberg Anywhere/Terminal, etc.)
  • Basic Network troubleshooting (DNS, DHCP, Network slowdowns, remote VPN/VDI connectivity problems, etc.)
  • Consistently logging and monitoring service tickets to ensure fast, thorough resolution and documentation of every issue through JIRA Service Desk
  • Office moves and build outs
  • Device inventory and asset management
  • Employee onboarding/offboarding

 

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:


In order to effectively represent the Company and communicate with clients, the employee must be someone who has:   


  • Minimum 5 years desktop support experience at hedge fund or investment advisor
  • Exceptional customer service with strong written and oral communication skills
  • Strong drive and passion for technology and self-development
  • Strong problem-solving skills, high attention to detail and quick to learn both user and system environments
  • Ability to work independently and multi-task
  • Keen attention to detail, with commitment to follow through and follow-up
  • Extensive understanding of desktop support standards and best practices including related hardware and software
  • Experience supporting mobile devices
  • Experience supporting remote users and troubleshooting remote VPN/VDI connections
  • Knowledge of PowerShell, scripting, automation, and packaging (Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager) is a plus
  • Travel may be required across all office locations for coverage and/or initiatives


Don’t have all of the skills listed above? Have extra skills you think are important that we haven’t thought of? Please, let us know by applying and telling us a bit more about yourself and why you think you’re qualified!

  • In-depth technical knowledge and expertise

The Firm


XTX Markets is a leading algorithmic trading firm which uses state-of-the-art machine learning technology to produce price forecasts for over 53,000 financial instruments across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and crypto. It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 300 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.

We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.

XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing over 25,000 GPUs with more than 1 exabyte of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.

At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. We are focused on teamwork and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do.


The Role

The technology and market data procurement department is responsible for achieving value for the firm in the execution of a budget in the hundreds of millions of pounds annually.

This role supports the research, evaluation, sourcing, procurement, and commercial management of technology products and services across the entire firm.

A key aspect of the role is staying up to date with emerging technologies, market trends and vendor capabilities, providing technology guidance and strategic recommendations to engineering, infrastructure and business development teams to support the firm’s technology decisions.

The portfolio includes IT hardware, enterprise software, cloud services, market data, network and connectivity services, datacentre and colocation services, professional services and emerging technologies. You will get broad exposure to a wide range of cutting-edge technology deployments.

You will work closely with engineering, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to understand their requirements, evaluate technical and commercial options, negotiate with suppliers, and support implementation. We are seeking someone who combines sound commercial judgement with the technical aptitude to research unfamiliar technologies, assess vendor proposals and manage initiatives from initial requirements through contract, delivery and lifecycle management.


Responsibilities

  • Research, evaluate, negotiate and procure technology products and services across hardware, software, cloud, market data, network and connectivity, datacentre and colocation, professional services and emerging technologies.
  • Lead structured sourcing processes, including requirements definition, RFIs, RFPs, vendor due diligence, proposal evaluation, commercial negotiation, contract review, purchase approvals and implementation handover.
  • Work with engineering, infrastructure, information security, legal, finance and business teams to define requirements and assess technical options, vendor roadmaps, licensing and commercial models, support arrangements, implementation risks and total cost of ownership.
  • Support the procurement and delivery of complex infrastructure projects, including compute, GPU, storage, network, power, cooling, datacentre capacity and exchange connectivity requirements.
  • Manage supplier relationships across OEMs, resellers, software and cloud providers, market data vendors, network carriers, datacentre and colocation providers and professional services firms.
  • Support the commercial and procurement workstreams of technology implementation projects, including supplier coordination, delivery planning, risk management, acceptance and operational handover.
  • Manage hardware and enterprise software asset lifecycles, including renewals, maintenance, support, utilisation, refresh planning and decommissioning.
  • Conduct cost reconciliation, spend analysis, budget tracking, vendor reporting and financial data administration.
  • Improve procurement processes, documentation, governance and stakeholder workflows.

Essential Attributes

If you resonate with some or all the following, we encourage you to apply:

  • Approximately 3 to 6 years of experience in technology procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor management, solutions architecture, technical project delivery, infrastructure sourcing or a related role.
  • Strong technical aptitude and a practical understanding of enterprise technology environments, with the ability to assess requirements, dependencies, implementation considerations and supplier proposals.
  • Experience sourcing or delivering complex infrastructure, high-performance compute, GPU, datacentre, colocation, low-latency network or direct-liquid-cooled technology
  • Broad knowledge of technology products or services across several categories, such as hardware, software, cloud, data, telecommunications, datacentre services or professional services.
  • Ability to quickly develop knowledge of unfamiliar or emerging technologies and engage credibly with specialist engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Commercially astute, with experience running structured sourcing and negotiation processes and evaluating commercial models, contractual terms, supplier risk and total cost of ownership.
  • Proven project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and balance technical, commercial, logistical, operational and risk considerations.
  • Effective communicator with strong stakeholder and vendor management skills, capable of translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and commercial constraints for technical stakeholders.
  • Articulate, analytical and numerate, with strong verbal and written reasoning skills and a bachelor's degree in an analytical, technical, engineering, scientific, financial or quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience working in financial services, trading, research computing or another technically demanding environment would be advantageous.

  • Breakfast and lunch provided daily.
  • Various supports for caregivers, including emergency dependent care.
  • Beautiful Kings Cross office: (Office Tour).
  • 25 days paid holiday per year + statutory holiday and paid sick days.
  • Generous Pension contributions.

The Firm

XTX Markets is a leading algorithmic trading firm which uses state-of-the-art machine learning technology to produce price forecasts for over 53,000 financial instruments across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and crypto. It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 300 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.

We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.

XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing well over 25,000 GPUs with more than 1 exabyte of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.

At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. We are focused on teamwork and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do.


The Role

Shared Engineering is a mixed-discipline platform team of around a dozen engineers (network engineers, Linux engineers, and software developers). The team owns the foundations that the firm's engineering runs on such as alerting, job scheduling, host inventory/monitoring, and the internal developer tooling for our monorepo. This includes shared libraries, build systems and CI/CD infrastructure.

Our aim is to give the firm's engineers leverage: fewer manual steps, delivery that is fast and predictable, and teams who can self-serve rather than raising a ticket and waiting. We have many initiatives in flight at once, so judgement about which thing to work on matters nearly as much as building it well.

This is a software-developer role on the team focused on developer experience and platform software: building the tools, services, and libraries that make everyone else's engineering faster and more reliable. A growing part of that remit is how the firm's engineers adopt AI and coding-assistant tooling. Recent work includes our self-service network configuration tools, sandboxing and gateway services for coding assistants, and pulling host inventory data into a single source of truth.


Responsibilities

  • Working primarily in Go, build and own platform services and internal tooling end-to-end, from design through to production.
  • Improve developer experience by reducing friction in the build/CI/CD path, strengthen shared libraries.
  • Help shape how the wider firm adopts AI/coding-assistant tooling safely and effectively, integrating it into workflows and building guardrails and tooling around it.
  • Collaborate with the network and Linux engineers to understand what the infrastructure needs in order to scale and be managed, then expose it cleanly in software.
  • Mentor and share knowledge, improving teammates' skills and making sure others can maintain and build on the systems you develop.
  • Review and raise standards by thoughtful code review, sensible judgement on where to block versus where to let things flow, and a pragmatic sense of the right work to be doing right now.
  • Take part in on-call once up-to-speed, troubleshooting problems that span several technical domains across current and legacy infrastructure.

Essential attributes

  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals and production experience owning services end-to-end. Go is what you'd write day to day, but we care more about the fundamentals than the language: strong backgrounds in other statically typed languages are welcome.
  • Comfortable on Linux, with an understanding of the OS your software runs on (processes, networking basics, packaging, systemd), even if you're not a systems engineer.
  • Solid grasp of build systems, CI/CD, and release pipelines. You've worked in a monorepo or a serious build/release setup and made it better.
  • A track record of delivering: shipping, closing out, and not letting scope or polish stall a deliverable.
  • Good written and verbal communication, and the collaborative instinct to treat non-developer engineers as first-class colleagues.

Desirable attributes

Things we'd like to see. You won't have all of them, and that's fine.

  • Interest or hands-on experience in developer experience and AI/coding-assistant tooling. Building or integrating LLMs into a real engineering workflow is a plus, but curiosity about how these tools change work practices counts too.
  • Experience with infrastructure/platform software: inventory/asset systems, monitoring, alerting, scheduling, container orchestration or similar backend platform work.
  • APIs, data pipelines and schema management: designing clean service APIs and moving data between systems reliably.
  • Infrastructure-as-code and cloud fluency. We use Terraform and AWS as required, but experience with Azure or GCP is just as relevant.
  • The role is not managing hardware, networks or datacenters. However, you will collaborate closely with teams that do, so experience in these areas is valuable.

About the Position

We’re looking for Software Engineers who want to help us design and build the systems and tools that run the firm. You’ll find Software Engineers in all parts of Jane Street, solving real problems in critical areas ranging from trading desks to our accounting team, as well as building foundational infrastructure, whether that means implementing network monitoring or risk models. 

We are big believers in functional programming and, using OCaml, a statically -typed functional programming language, as our primary tool. More recently, Python has become a vital part of Jane Street’s research and trading work, acting as the go-to language for data analysis, visualization, and machine learning. 

Beyond our own environment, we also recognize the value of open source software, leveraging it in our daily work and releasing over a million lines of our own code as open source. We’re also always looking for ways to expand open source projects, and provide ongoing support to things like Mercurial, the OCaml compiler, and the OPAM package manager. That said, we’re interested in talented engineers with experience in any language—most of us came in with little to no practical experience in OCaml before we joined.

If you’d like to learn more, you can read about our interview process and meet some of our newest hires.

About You

We don’t expect you to have a background in functional programming, OCaml, Python, finance, or any other specific field—we’re looking for smart programmers who enjoy solving interesting problems. We’re more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

  • A top-notch programmer with a love for technology
  • Intellectually curious, collaborative, and eager to learn
  • Humble and unafraid to ask questions and admit mistakes
  • Fluent in English

If you'd like to get an idea of what we cover in our software engineering interview process, you can visit our interview prep page.

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

About This Position

We are seeking an adaptable and innovative Senior Private Company Valuation Manager to lead the successful management and execution of diverse projects with moderate to high risk and complexity. This role will focus on valuing private equity and private credit positions held by T. Rowe Price's funds.

Role Summary

The primary purpose of the team and this position is to prepare valuations of private investments - both private equity and private credit securities - held by T. Rowe Price and related funds. Valuations will conclude recommended fair values for our positions under guidelines established by T. Rowe Price’s Valuation Committee. The fair value ultimately is used as an input into our funds' NAVs, which are disclosed in our quarterly SEC filings and reviewed in various capacities including by our external auditors. This role requires the ability to determine recommended prices of difficult to value securities, provide robust documentation in support of the valuations, and defend and communicate the valuations to both internal and external constituents. The position sits within T. Rowe Price's Global Investment Operations department. 

Responsibilities

Valuation Activities:

  • Through collecting a mosaic of information, the responsibility of the associate is to calculate, monitor, and communicate valuations of private company investments.  It will also be expected that the professional is comfortable defending the principles employed and decisions made in the valuation recommendation.  The valuation process includes spending time reviewing company and industry backgrounds, available financial information, internal projections, management projections, and/or financial market inputs.  Analysis and inputs used will include prior transaction values, comparable company valuation analysis, comparable transaction valuation analysis, and/or discounted cash flow (DCF) models.  Ultimately, the work product needs to produce a conclusion of value and be audit ready relying on accepted standard valuation approaches and with a synthesized and documented valuation conclusion.
  • Ability to handle and debate common valuation challenges arising from our private company investments.  For example, this may include any discounts for lack of marketability, and interpreting the impact of preference terms, “ratchet” rights, treatment of stock-based compensation, or other deal specific differentiating features of private company transactions. 

Leadership Activities:

  • As a subject matter expert on our valuation process, it is expected that the individual will be able to operate within the framework of the role independently and initiate suggestions or improvements to the process when appropriate.  The role could also include participation in presentations, conferences, or meetings to improve and communicate our private company valuation process.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or the equivalent combination of education and relevant experience AND
  • 8+ years of total relevant work experience.

Preferred:

  • Experience in valuing private equity and private credit securities, and analyzing complex capital structures associated with PE/VC transactions.
  • Strong knowledge of both theoretical and practical valuation concepts and standards including equity, debt, and firm level invested capital analysis and familiarity with valuation guidelines including the Accounting and Valuation Guide (Valuation of Portfolio Company Investments of Venture Capital and Private Equity Funds and Other Investment Companies) published by the AICPA strongly preferred.
  • Identifying, reviewing, and integrating relevant information from a variety of sources and developing the complex financial models required to assess values of businesses in various (including early) stages of their life cycle.  Experience with highly valued technology, biotech, and/or pre-revenue companies is a plus.
  • Preferably, candidates will have at least one valuation related credential such as; Chartered Financial Analyst Designation (CFA); Certified Public Accountant Accredited in Business Valuation (CPA/ABV); Certified Valuation Analyst (CVA); or Accredited Senior Appraiser (ASA).  CFA Charter holder’s designation strongly preferred.
  • Desire to work in a middle-office environment supporting a fast-paced investment process.
  • Experience with Excel models and analytical/research tools such as Bloomberg, FactSet, or S&P Capital IQ

As a Systems Software Engineer on our Network Capture Services team, you will help build and operate the firm's network packet capture platform. The data our capture systems produce is relied on daily by trading, research, and support teams, and they treat it as mission critical. You will work alongside experienced software and systems engineers who share operational responsibility for everything we ship.

This role is broader than a typical systems software engineering role. You will write software (C++, Python, Rust, Ruby), and you will also spend a significant share of your time on systems and infrastructure work: specifying, building, and deploying capture servers, automating that process with Ansible, and coordinating with our data center, systems administration, network engineering, and purchasing teams to get it done. You will take a regular turn on the team's weekly production support rotation, and there is steady feature development work alongside it. If you want a role with real breadth, genuine ownership of what you deploy, and you like to be challenged, this is for you. This role is based in our Chicago headquarters.

What you'll be working on

  • Designing, building, deploying, and validating network capture servers, and driving that work to completion across every team involved
  • Developing and maintaining our capture and query software (C++, Python, Rust, Ruby) with a constant focus on testing, reliability, and performance
  • Building the Ansible automation, configuration management, and deployment tooling that makes capture server provisioning repeatable rather than manual
  • Taking a regular turn on the team's weekly production support rotation: troubleshooting live capture issues, coordinating incident response, and monitoring proactively to catch problems before our users do
  • Improving automation, monitoring, and capacity planning, and seeing your own proposals through to production
  • Onboarding new capture deployments in partnership with the stakeholder teams that depend on them
  • Serving as a liaison between Network Capture Services and the infrastructure teams we work with

You will be right at home if you have

  • 3+ years of professional systems software engineering experience, strong skills in a systems language such as Rust, C/C++, or Go, and a genuine willingness to make C++ your primary language. Ruby and Rust experience are both a plus.
  • Experience with DPDK or comparable kernel-bypass packet processing, including the concepts that come with it — hugepages, CPU pinning and core isolation, NUMA awareness, poll-mode drivers
  • Strong Linux skills, including administration and troubleshooting of production servers. RHEL-family experience is a plus, as is a background as a Linux administrator or network engineer.
  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing, switching, NICs, packet analysis
  • Hands-on experience with server hardware and data center workflows — specifying and validating builds, working through remote hands, rack and cabling coordination, firmware and BIOS, out-of-band management
  • Experience with Ansible or a comparable configuration management tool
  • Comfort and effectiveness coordinating work across infrastructure teams you do not sit on, and patience for the follow-through that requires
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and package management. Kubernetes and GitOps tooling such as Flux or Helm are a plus.
  • Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, Ruby, or similar
  • A habit of working on systems with a constant focus on testing, reliability, scalability, and maintainability
  • Experience with commercial network capture products is a plus, as is performance analysis tooling experience (perf, eBPF, flamegraphs, tcpdump) and contributions to the DPDK ecosystem beyond application-level use
  • Familiarity with service discovery, secrets management, metrics and dashboarding, and relational databases
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Availability for the weekly production support rotation, which includes some off-hours, nights, and weekends; composure in occasional high-pressure situations; and a strong sense of urgency in support of our internal clients

XTX Markets is a leading algorithmic trading firm which uses state-of-the-art machine learning technology to produce price forecasts for over 53,000 financial instruments across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and crypto. It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 300 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.

We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.

XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing well over 25,000 GPUs with more than 1 exabyte of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.

The Information Security team at XTX Markets is accountable for all aspects of the firm’s IT security. From obtaining and transforming events and signals into actionable intelligence, to helping design and implement authentication and authorisation systems, and other security tools that underpin the XTX environment.

The team also assess third party security, as well as working diligently to keep XTX in compliance with a range of world-wide regulatory information security requirements.

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for XTX Markets users and developers. In this role, you will work with software engineers to proactively identify security flaws and engineer technical solutions to a defensive mindset.

This is a hands-on role. XTX prides itself on its ability to create and maintain software and systems that precisely meet our needs.

We handle information at large scale and across multiple locations, so we need to anticipate and protect against attackers. You will work closely with teams to improve our detection capabilities, and to design defence-in-depth controls that limit attackers' ability to move inside our network.

At XTX, security engineers are engaged in requirements gathering, architecting, prototyping, and developing both internal tools and broader infrastructure in conjunction with partner teams around XTX.

THE POSITION

The Solution Architect serves as the lead architecture partner for one or more business products, platforms, or delivery teams. This role is responsible for translating business objectives, product strategies, and enterprise architecture guidance into practical solution designs that are scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable, and aligned with Wellington’s technology standards.

The Solution Architect works directly with Product Owners, Engineers, Technical Leads, Product Managers, Delivery Leads, and Enterprise Architects to shape the technical direction of product teams. The role balances short-term delivery needs with long-term architecture sustainability, ensuring solutions support both immediate business outcomes and future platform evolution.

The individual in this role must be comfortable moving between strategy, design, engineering, governance, and stakeholder engagement. They help teams solve complex technology challenges, manage dependencies, define non-functional requirements, and make effective technology decisions while maintaining alignment with Wellington’s architecture principles and standards.

Success in this role comes through technical leadership, collaboration, influence, and a demonstrated ability to help teams deliver high-quality solutions that create measurable business value.

1. Solution Design and Architecture Leadership

  • Lead architecture and technical design activities for one or more products, platforms, or solution domains.
  • Translate business requirements, product vision, and operational objectives into end-to-end solution architectures.
  • Create logical, physical, integration, data, security, and deployment architectures for business initiatives.
  • Ensure solutions balance functionality, scalability, maintainability, resiliency, performance, cost, and operational supportability.
  • Produce architecture artifacts and design documentation that clearly communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs.
  • Guide engineering teams through architecture implementation and ensure design intent is maintained throughout delivery.

2. Product Roadmaps and Technology Planning

  • Partner with Product Owners and technology leaders to define architecture roadmaps and technical runways that support product evolution.
  • Identify technology dependencies, architecture constraints, modernization opportunities, and technical debt reduction initiatives.
  • Ensure architecture investment decisions align with product priorities and long-term platform goals.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architects to ensure product roadmaps are aligned with enterprise technology strategies.
  • Support planning activities by identifying solution risks, required architecture investments, and implementation sequencing.
  • Help teams make informed build-versus-buy decisions based on business value, risk, complexity, and strategic alignment.

3. Architecture Governance and Standards Alignment

  • Ensure solution designs adhere to Wellington’s architecture standards, patterns, principles, and governance requirements.
  • Participate in Architecture Review Board reviews and architecture working groups where required.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architects to address architecture findings, design recommendations, and governance requirements.
  • Maintain traceability between architecture decisions, business requirements, and approved standards.
  • Contribute reusable patterns, design approaches, and implementation learnings back into the architecture community.
  • Support post-implementation architecture validations and design reviews.
  • Support post-implementation architecture reviews and validations to confirm that delivered solutions remain aligned with approved architecture direction and non-functional requirements.
  • Partner with technology risk, information security, infrastructure, data, and AI governance teams to ensure architecture decisions appropriately address control, compliance, resilience, and operational expectations.

4. Application, Data, and Integration Architecture

  • Design solutions that leverage strategic enterprise platforms, shared services, APIs, events, governed data products, and reusable business capabilities.

  • Guide teams on cloud-native design, infrastructure-as-code, automation, platform engineering, and deployment strategies.

  • Design architectures that incorporate monitoring, logging, telemetry, fault tolerance, and recovery capabilities.
  • Partner with Information Security, Infrastructure, Risk Management, and Operations teams to address architecture risks proactively.

Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. About the Role

The Equity Product Management (“EPM”) group at Wellington Management works closely with our equity investment teams, relationship teams, and business colleagues across the firm to support our clients’ investment needs. Our equity investors span a wide range of disciplines, geographies, industries, market capitalizations, and styles. The product management function has three main objectives:

  • Product Development and Marketing: EPM contributes to client growth and retention by assessing business opportunities and leading business planning, developing new products and investment solutions, creating the communication strategy for the book of business, including materials that differentiate the product relative to competitors and acting as a subject matter expert and portfolio representative for colleagues, clients and consultants.
  • Investment Integrity and Risk Management: EPM acts as an independent advisor to ensure the integrity of the investment and risk management processes, as well as consistency with client parameters and objectives, conducts regular product risk and performance attributions reviews, and contributes to formal, investment review group processes.
  • Business Management: EPM contributes to business management, including managing risk, capacity, pricing and guidelines, leads resolution of internal business challenges, and collaborates on product management business to share investment integrity, marketing and product development best practices.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES 
The Investment Analyst will work as part of one or more product coverage teams to contribute to the broad efforts of EPM. The primary focus of the role is to provide analytical leverage to the team as well as be a point of contact for a variety of internal constituents regarding inquiries about the investment teams and products under coverage. Responsibilities include performing analyses related to portfolio positioning, attribution and risk, market trends, competitive positioning, and pricing.  Additional responsibilities may include creation and maintenance of marketing and client materials, review of RFPs, responses to client questions, automation of workflow, presenting in select external client meetings, and collaboration on the development of client solutions and new investment approaches.

  • Strong technical skills; mastery of MS Excel, familiarity with Factset, and comfort working with AI tools are a plus but not essential

About Us

Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.

About the Role

Wellington Management is seeking an Executive Assistant to provide dedicated support to investors on the Industrials & Energy team. This role serves as a trusted administrative partner, working closely with investment professionals to help manage competing priorities, coordinate complex logistics, and ensure seamless execution across a broad range of business activities.

The Executive Assistant will play a critical role in supporting a fast-paced, highly dynamic investment environment. This position carries significant responsibility for managing complex calendars, coordinating extensive domestic and international travel, facilitating high volumes of internal and external meetings, and ensuring day-to-day team activities run smoothly. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to remain flexible as priorities evolve.

We are seeking a highly motivated and resourceful professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys building strong relationships across a team. The ideal candidate combines a proactive mindset with a high degree of patience, adaptability, and service orientation. They are comfortable engaging with a wide range of stakeholders, take initiative without being asked, and bring a positive, solutions-focused approach to both routine responsibilities and unexpected challenges. This role is particularly well suited for someone who enjoys being deeply connected to the business, values partnership, and takes pride in creating a seamless experience for those they support.

Primary Responsibilities

The Executive Assistant will serve as a trusted administrative partner to investors on the Industrials & Energy team, helping ensure priorities are executed efficiently and team activities run seamlessly. Responsibilities include:

  • Provide proactive, high-quality administrative support to investment professionals, anticipating needs and helping manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Manage complex and highly active calendars, balancing shifting schedules, competing demands, and time-sensitive internal and external meeting requests with sound judgment and attention to detail.

  • Coordinate extensive domestic and international travel, including multi-leg itineraries, accommodations, and last-minute changes requiring flexibility and problem-solving.

  • Plan and execute logistics for a high volume of internal and external meetings, partnering with colleagues, external organizations, and administrative professionals to ensure a seamless experience for all participants.

  • Support conference planning and coordination, including registration, scheduling, travel arrangements, and materials preparation.

  • Assist with the coordination of team meetings, recurring group activities, and offsites.

  • Manage expense reports, including preparation, submission, reconciliation, and follow-up to ensure timely and accurate processing in line with firm policies.

  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the firm, serving as a responsive, professional, and trusted point of contact.

  • Exercise discretion and judgment when handling confidential information, sensitive matters, and requests requiring thoughtful prioritization.

  • Remain actively engaged in team priorities and dynamics, helping drive follow-through, coordination, and continuity across a wide range of activities.

  • Provide cross-coverage and backup support to other Executive Assistants as needed, contributing to a collaborative administrative team.

  • Support ad hoc projects and evolving initiatives, demonstrating curiosity, flexibility, and a willingness to take on new responsibilities.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years' experience within an administrative role in a professional services organization.

  • Experience supporting senior stakeholders in a fast-paced environment with significant travel, scheduling complexity, and competing priorities.

  • Experience coordinating domestic and international travel, meeting logistics, and expense management.

  • Exposure to investment management, financial services, or similarly dynamic professional environments will be viewed favorably.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office with an ability and desire to learn new technology to drive efficiencies.

  • Demonstrated strong detail orientation, diligence, and commitment to high-quality work.

  • Excellent organizational, multitasking, and prioritization abilities.

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the confidence to build strong relationships across a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Proactive problem-solving skills and an anticipatory mindset.

  • High level of reliability, professionalism, and discretion.

  • Ability to adapt communication style to different audiences and navigate changing priorities with patience and composure.

  • Positive, can-do attitude, flexibility, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach to teamwork.

Role overview

Maven Securities is a technology-driven proprietary trading firm, running options market making, high frequency and multi-strategy discretionary trading from London, Amsterdam, and offices across the US and Asia. We are creating a single, global owner for employment law, reporting directly to the Chief Legal Officer.

This is the first role of its kind at Maven, with a broad global remit. You will own every employee relations matter end to end. You will advise the CLO, the C-suite, and the Chief People Officer directly, and you will set the standard for how Maven handles its people issues in every jurisdiction where we employ.

The operating model is already established: the role structure, work allocation process, service standards, escalation framework and reporting pack are built and running in the UK. 

Maven Legal is nimble, focused, senior, and commercial: you will be trusted with the whole of your subject from day one.

Key responsibilities

Employee relations and casework

  • Own every ER Legal matter across the group: disciplinary, grievance, performance, absence, restructuring, and contentious matters.
  • Be the single point of contact for managers and HR. Answer the same day on anything genuinely time-critical.
  • Run each case against one consistent playbook, so outcomes are consistent.
  • Spot the patterns, improve processes and policies, make a difference and produce better outcomes.

Advisory and risk

  • Advise the founders, C-suite, Chief People Officer and CLO on employment risks in plain, commercial language, with a clear recommendation rather than a menu of options.
  • Give the practical answer alongside the legal one. We want to know what the risk actually is, why it matters here, and what you would do.
  • Escalate to the CLO on anything strategic, precedent-setting, or reputationally material.

Litigation and disputes

  • Run employment tribunal claims and their equivalents in other jurisdictions, work with HR on ACAS early conciliation, from first response to resolution.
  • Lead on restrictive covenant and non-solicitation enforcement, bonus disputes, and contentious exits, instructing and directing external counsel where local law requires it.

Policies, contracts and documentation

  • Own the employment contract suite, the policy library, and the handbook across every jurisdiction, keeping them current with legislative change.
  • Create global templates to ensure consistency in approach and outcomes: bonus letters and policies, settlement agreements, restrictive covenants, and communications to staff.
  • Run an annual policy review programme rather than fixing policies after they fail.

Global coverage

  • Build the coordination protocol that keeps group-wide matters consistent.
  • Manage local counsel where local qualification is required, and identify cross-border inconsistencies at an early stage.

Legal operations and AI

  • Bring AI and legal technology into the employment workflow, in line with Maven Legal’s aim to be one of the best equipped and most technology-capable legal teams in our industry.
  • Build the templates, playbooks and self-service materials that let managers handle the routine well and escalate the rest early.

Stakeholder engagement and training

  • Build trusted relationships with managers and HR so that issues are escalated early.
  • Deliver practical training to HR, managers and the wider legal team.
  • Manage the employment panel and the external spend that goes with it.

 

What we are looking for

Essential

  • Qualified solicitor in England and Wales, c.6 to 10 years PQE, with employment law as your primary practice.
  • Strong contentious track record: you have run tribunal claims yourself, not just supervised them.
  • Comfortable advising senior stakeholders directly, and confident holding a position with a founder in the room.
  • Commercial and practical. You can explain why an indemnity or a covenant matters in this specific situation, and you do the work to know.
  • Able to operate as the only specialist in your subject, with the judgment to know what to escalate.

Desirable

  • In-house experience in financial services, ideally trading, hedge funds, or another high-performance environment.
  • Exposure to multi-jurisdictional employment work, particularly US or Dutch.
  • Experience bringing AI or legal technology into a legal workflow.
  • Experience of bonus and incentive disputes, and of covenant enforcement.

 

What We Can Offer You:

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Annual discretionary bonus
  • Group pension plan
  • Enhanced annual leave allowance after 2+ years’ service
  • 25 days’ annual leave (plus public holidays)
  • Fully catered breakfast, lunch, and snacks prepared by an in-house chef
  • Private healthcare and life assurance
  • On-site private gym with instructor-led classes including boxing, yoga, and more
  • Monthly company events and social activities
  • Work in a forward-thinking environment where AI is integral to our strategy and daily operations

Role Summary

The ETF Capital Markets Analyst supports the ETF Capital Markets team in promoting efficient trading, liquidity, and primary and secondary market activity across T. Rowe Price’s ETF platform. The role serves as a resource for monitoring ETF market quality, supporting external ETF trading relationships, and responding to ETF trading and liquidity-related inquiries. The Analyst will monitor ETF trading and creation/redemption activity, maintain market surveillance and analytics, support new ETF launches, and assist with relationships across authorized participants, market makers, exchanges, trading desks, and other ETF ecosystem partners. This role will work closely with ETF Capital Markets team members and internal partners across Distribution, Operations, Trading, Portfolio Management, Product, Legal, and Compliance.

Responsibilities

ETF Market Monitoring & Analytics:

  • Monitor trading activity, liquidity, spreads, premiums/discounts, volumes, and other market quality indicators across T. Rowe Price ETFs.
  • Conduct ongoing analysis of primary and secondary market activity to identify trends, potential issues, and opportunities to improve ETF trading and liquidity.
  • Develop and maintain market surveillance tools, dashboards, databases, and recurring ETF capital markets reporting.
  • Monitor ETF creation/redemption activity, basket activity, and authorized participant engagement.
  • Analyze competitor ETFs and broader market activity to provide context on trading and liquidity trends.
  • Escalate time sensitive issues and situations to senior ETF Capital Markets team members as appropriate.

Capital Markets Partner Support:

  • Support day-to-day interactions with authorized participants, market makers, institutional sales and trading desks, exchanges, wealth execution platforms, and other ETF capital markets partners.
  • Assist the Capital Markets team in monitoring market maker and authorized participant activity and engagement.
  • Support onboarding and ongoing coordination with ETF liquidity providers.  
  • Assist with coordination related to create/redeem activity, basket questions, client facilitation, and other trading-related matters.

Primary Market & Platform Support:

  • Support efforts to enhance the ETF primary market platform and authorized participant experience.
  • Monitor creation/redemption activity and help identify trends or issues requiring attention and follow-up.
  • Assist with authorized participant onboarding, documentation, testing, and ongoing platform support.
  • Assist with operational and technology initiatives designed to improve ETF trading and primary market processes.

Sales & Client Support:

  • Support Distribution with ETF trading, liquidity, and capital markets-related inquiries.
  • Provide trading and liquidity analysis to support institutional and intermediary client conversations.
  • Assist senior ETF Capital Markets team members with preparation and follow-up for client and trading partner meetings.
  • Prepare ETF trading analytics and supporting materials for client, ETF business, and internal discussions.

ETF Launch & Cross-Functional Support:

  • Support capital markets readiness for new ETF launches, including coordination with authorized participants, market makers, exchanges, operations, portfolio management, and other internal partners.
  • Monitor trading and liquidity following ETF launches and provide relevant analysis to the Capital Markets team and key stakeholders.
  • Work with Distribution, Operations, Trading, Portfolio Management, Product, Legal, and Compliance on ETF-related initiatives and day-to-day activity.

Industry, Governance & Reporting Support:

  • Monitor relevant ETF market structure, trading, regulatory, and industry developments.
  • Support research and analysis related to changes affecting ETF trading and the broader ETF ecosystem.
  • Assist with ETF governance, compliance, and oversight requirements.
  • Maintain internal reporting, databases, and ETF analytics tools.
  • Help prepare materials and analysis for internal governance and business reviews.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in financial services, asset management, trading, capital markets, investment operations, or a related function.
  • Understanding of ETFs, financial markets, and trading concepts.
  • Experience with Bloomberg and/or other investment and ETF data platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to analyze complex information, identify relevant issues, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.

Preferred:

  • ETF capital markets or ETF trading experience strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of ETF product structure, primary and secondary market mechanics, creation/redemption processes, baskets, liquidity, and trading.
  • Familiarity with key participants in the ETF ecosystem, including authorized participants, market makers, exchanges, custodians, and trading desks.
  • Experience analyzing ETF spreads, premiums/discounts, volumes, liquidity, and other market quality metrics.
  • Familiarity with ETF market structure and relevant regulatory considerations.
  • FINRA Series 7 and 63 preferred or ability to obtain as required.

FINRA Requirements

FINRA licenses are not required.
